description: A dim, candlelit electronics workbench painting. A analog multimeter with a needle dial and red and black probes sits at left, with a lit candle behind it. At the back sits a beige 1980s desktop computer with a CRT monitor and a floppy drive. In the centre, a green circuit board holds a large square chip in a ceramic package, surrounded by ribbon cables, capacitors and resistors. Notebooks with scribbled handwriting lie at the edges. No people are visible.
